parrafo_1.es: Coastland Carpentry es un equipo de carpinteria en Jacksonville, FL liderado por Sam: built-ins de sala, paredes de shiplap y texturizadas, closets a medida y trabajo de escalera, pensados para cada casa en particular.
parrafo_1.en: Coastland Carpentry is a Jacksonville, FL carpentry team led by Sam: living room built-ins, shiplap and textured accent walls, custom closets and staircase work, planned around each home.

parrafo_2.es: Las resenas repiten lo mismo: Sam escucha las ideas de diseno del cliente, cuida cada detalle y entrega un acabado que se nota apenas se entra al cuarto.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews say the same thing over and over: Sam listens to the client's design ideas, pays attention to every detail, and leaves a finish you notice the moment you walk into the room.

texto.es: Cuentas que espacio quieres transformar: una sala, un closet, una pared o una escalera.
texto.en: Tell the team which space you want to transform: a living room, a closet, a wall or a staircase.

texto.es: Compartes fotos de inspiracion y Sam te ayuda a convertirlas en un diseno real para tu casa.
texto.en: You share inspiration photos and Sam helps turn them into a real design for your home.

texto.es: El equipo construye e instala cada pieza en sitio, con el mismo cuidado que ves en las fotos.
texto.en: The team builds and installs every piece on site, with the same care you see in the photos.

texto.es: Revisan juntos el resultado final. Guardas el numero directo para el proximo proyecto.
texto.en: You walk the finished result together. Keep the direct number for the next project.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza segun el alcance. Llama y te dan un presupuesto directo.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on scope. Call for a straight quote.

texto.es: Unidades de pared a medida con repisas, gabinetes y espacio para la chimenea o el televisor.
texto.en: Custom built-in wall units with shelving, cabinetry and space for a fireplace or TV.

texto.es: Shiplap, board and batten y disenos geometricos de pared, instalados a medida en cualquier cuarto.
texto.en: Shiplap, board and batten and geometric accent wall designs, custom fit for any room.

texto.es: Sistemas de closet, repisas flotantes y libreros construidos para el espacio exacto que tienes.
texto.en: Closet systems, floating shelves and bookcases built to fit the exact space you have.

texto.es: Barandas, molduras de escalera y bancas de entrada con gancheras, hechas a medida para tu casa.
texto.en: Stair railings, stair trim and mudroom entry benches with hooks, custom built for your home.

pie.es: Tu proyecto no esta en la lista? Llama igual, el equipo te dice si puede ayudarte.
pie.en: Does your project not fit the list? Call anyway, the team will tell you if they can help.

items.quote: We hired Sam to complete three projects in our home: shiplap the entire office, shiplap an accent wall in our bedroom, and add wall texture to our kid's room. Sam was professional and did great work. I appreciated his attention to detail. We are very happy with the way all projects turned out.

Sam at Coastland Carpentry did a great job from my initial contact showing him some design ideas to bringing it to a beautiful finish in my home. Responsive, talented and care to detail are just a few of the words describing the overall experience. Can't say enough about his work. Highly recommended!

Highly recommend Coastland Carpentry! Sam and team were great. The team was extremely professional and executed the project on time. The attention to detail and craftsmanship was outstanding and we plan to use them for future projects.
